facts.text: The repository describes dsynth as specialized ManiSkill environments for retail setups, with scene generation, motion planning and policy evaluation
The ManiSkill simulator requires the Vulkan API
The README instructs downloading RoboCasa assets and the RoboBenchMart assets from separate sources
MoveFromBoardToBoardVanishContEnv is registered with max_episode_steps=200000
MoveFromBoardToBoardContEnv documents the task as picking the target item and placing it one board higher, with the robot spawned near the shelf
DarkstoreCellBaseEnv derives from ManiSkill's BaseEnv
The environment constructor requires config_dir_path, the scene directory
reset accepts seed and options and reads reconfigure and robot_init_pose_seed from the options
The policy client builds the environment with gym.make(env_id, config_dir_path=<scene dir>, num_envs=1, control_mode=..., ...)
The policy client resets the environment with a seed and an options dictionary
The policy client calls env.step(action) and receives obs, reward, done, trunc and info
The policy client zeroes action[8] and action[9], so its action vectors have at least ten float components
The policy client reads three RGB camera images and the agent qpos from the observation
The target size is 0.3 m on each axis
The placement tolerance is half of target_sizes on each axis
The robot is static when its q velocity is below 0.2
A non-target product counts as displaced when its pose leaves the initial pose by more than rtol/atol 0.1
The success condition is object placed and robot static and no non-target product displaced
The interboard height is 0.397 m
The task docstring says the target item must be within TARGET_POS_THRESH of the goal, other items move by no more than 0.1 m and the robot q velocity stays below 0.2

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the initial joint state and the kinematic update is deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; the fake uses Python's random.Random and was never compared with ManiSkill's RNG

gaps: the fake is kinematic: each joint moves by a fixed placeholder gain per step; there are no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors, cameras, lighting or textures

the real environment runs ManiSkill/SAPIEN and needs Vulkan plus scene data and assets downloaded separately (README.md:15, README.md:45-55); the fake was never compared with it and the sim path was not run

NOT COVERED: the real observation is a ManiSkill dictionary with three RGB camera streams and the agent qpos (scripts/eval_policy_client.py:32-44); the fake returns only ten joint positions and publishes no observation schema
the action space is a ten-value Box in [-1, 1] (test data of the fake); the real action space comes from the ManiSkill controller and robot_uids and is not stated in the clone
the scene layout, product placement and target-product geometry are not modelled; the fake always reports success false
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, and the clone states no fixed timestep, so timestep_ms is 0 and ticks are uncalibrated control steps
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
